description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'CredentialsTest' for testing the deserialization behavior of the 'Credentials' class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. The test verifies that a JSON object representing client certificate credentials correctly maps to the expected Credentials subclass ‘ClientCertificateCredentials’.

classes.name: CredentialsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for unit testing the Credentials class' JSON deserialization logic.

methods.name: deserializeX509Credentials
methods.description: Test method that constructs a JSON object representing X509 credentials and verifies that it deserializes into a 'ClientCertificateCredentials' object.
